properties.description:
Repository Text editor feedback, comparing text and expression modes. Scope collapse/expand and subexpression/token-mode expansion use the same icon-button styling, although they perform different actions. Their placement also changes between modes, making the behavior feel unintuitive. No solution has been chosen.

Browser annotation 2 (verbatim):
"the fact we use the same icon button styling for collapse / expand of "scope" and for the subexpression / token mode when in expression mode and the placement is different between the two mode feel really bad and non intuitive as a human user. Put an inputs for this feedback i don't know how i want it solved though."

Selected control: Unfold line 240.
properties.title: Scope folding and token expansion are visually ambiguous
